description: Test class for the AuthenticationService in the OrangeHRM project, containing unit tests for setting user credentials under various scenarios.

classes.name: AuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the AuthenticationService component, testing credential setting logic.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials returns false when the user service returns null credentials.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithNotAssignedEss
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws an AuthenticationException for users with 'ESS' role not assigned to an employee.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithDisabledUser
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws an AuthenticationException when the user account is disabled.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithTerminatedEmployee
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws an AuthenticationException for employees whose termination record indicates they are terminated.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithoutEmployee
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws an AuthenticationException when the user has no associated employee record.

methods.name: testsSetCredentials
methods.description: Tests successful credential setting, verifying session variables are set and getAuthUser is called.
